name: Tiny AES in C
reason: No speed numbers against any baseline anywhere reachable. The README only gives code size (1171 bytes text for CTR-only on ARM with GCC 4.8.4 -Os, 903 bytes with -mthumb) and says it is 'designed for small code size and simplicity' and that if speed is a concern one should try Mbed TLS or OpenSSL. Issues #113 ('performance?') and #174 ('Performance seems much slower than openssl') contain no benchmark data; searches found no third-party shootout including it. Size-only claim, and the author disclaims speed.

name: tiny-ECDH-c
listed_description: Small and portable implementation of the ECDH key agreement protocol in C.
reason: No timing numbers against any baseline: README gives only code size (1413 bytes text with ARM GCC 4.8.4 -Os -mthumb, 2.1K ROM) and RAM (72 to 216 bytes per keypair), calling it the smallest ECC in C the author has seen. The 15 issue titles list no benchmark or speed discussion, and searches for comparisons with micro-ecc or mbedTLS found nothing for this repo. Size-only claim.
